The '''Oshora system''' was located in the [[Tolonda sector/Legends|Tolonda sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Oshora Rainbow Pearl Necklace]].<ref name="Shadows">{{LivingForce|Shadows in Green}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Oshora Rainbow Pearl Necklace]]|system=Oshora [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Oshora [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
